     # default ignore list for detailed views
     IGNORE = ('module', 'docuri', 'version_added', 'short_description', 'now_date', 'plainexamples', 'returndocs', 'collection')
 
+    _DOC_MACRO = re.compile(
+        r'(?<!\w)(?:(?P<single>[IBMUC])\((?P<value>[^)]+)\)'
+        r'|(?P<link>[LR])\((?P<label>[^,)]+),\s*(?P<target>[^)]+)\)'
+        r'|(?P<rule>HORIZONTALLINE)(?!\w))'
+    )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        def render(match):
+            if match.group('rule'):
+                return '\n-------------\n'
+
+            macro = match.group('single') or match.group('link')
+            value = match.group('value') or match.group('label')
+            if macro in ('I', 'C'):
+                return "`%s'" % value
+            if macro == 'B':
+                return '*%s*' % value
+            if macro == 'M':
+                return '[%s]' % value
+            if macro == 'L':
+                return '%s <%s>' % (value, match.group('target'))
+            return value  # U() and R()
+
+        return cls._DOC_MACRO.sub(render, text)
+
     def __init__(self, args):
 
         super(DocCLI, self).__init__(args)

+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+class TestDocCLITtyIfy(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_documentation_macros(self):
+        cases = (
+            ('I(italic)', "`italic'"),
+            ('B(bold)', '*bold*'),
+            ('M(module)', '[module]'),
+            ('U(https://example.com)', 'https://example.com'),
+            ('C(constant)', "`constant'"),
+            ('L(site,https://example.com)', 'site <https://example.com>'),
+            ('L(site, https://example.com)', 'site <https://example.com>'),
+            ('R(topic,reference)', 'topic'),
+            ('R(topic, reference)', 'topic'),
+            ('HORIZONTALLINE', '\n-------------\n'),
+        )
+        for source, expected in cases:
+            self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(source), expected)
+
+    def test_multiple_macros_and_plain_text(self):
+        source = 'Use M(name) with B(text), C(value), R(topic, reference), L(site, https://example.com), U(url), and I(note).'
+        expected = "Use [name] with *text*, `value', topic, site <https://example.com>, url, and `note'."
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(source), expected)
+
+    def test_unrelated_parenthesized_text(self):
+        source = 'IBM(International Business Machines) and FOOB(value) with X(other) and B(valid).'
+        expected = 'IBM(International Business Machines) and FOOB(value) with X(other) and *valid*.'
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(source), expected)
+
+    def test_rule_between_text(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('above HORIZONTALLINE below'), 'above \n-------------\n below')
